meta.home_title: MSiS — Tamsmunt n Inelmaden Imeslmen deg Stavanger
meta.home_desc: Tamsmunt yeldin i yiwen, yettwasewjeden s inelmaden, i inelmaden imeslmen n Tesdawit n Stavanger. Tettwasbedd deg 2014.
meta.about_desc: Issin MSiS, iswi-nneɣ, azalen-nneɣ d usqamu i yessufuɣen tamsmunt n inelmaden imeslmen.
meta.events_desc: Tidyanin i d-iteddun, taẓallit n Jjemɛa, tideggwin n umyannan d wahilen uzzigen n MSiS.
meta.membership_desc: Rnu ɣer MSiS baṭel. Yeldi i akk inelmaden imeslmen n tesdawit.
meta.prayer_desc: Lewqat n teẓallit n wass i Stavanger, ttwaleqqamen s wudem awurman.
meta.ramadan_desc: Ahil n Ṛemḍan n MSiS: tilɣa n lefṭur, taxemmemt d tmetti.

hero.tag: Tamsmunt n Inelmaden Imeslmen deg Stavanger · seg 2014
hero.h1: Axxam i inelmaden imeslmen n tesdawit
hero.sub: Yeldin, yettwasewjeden s inelmaden, yettmuqulen ɣer uzekka. Yeẓẓa deg wazalen igejdanen n Islam.

calligraphy.label: Azalen igejdanen
calligraphy.heading: Ɣef wacu nbedd
calligraphy.community_desc: Nettḥaraz iman-nneɣ d tesdawit i ɣ-d-yezzin

pillars.label: Acu nxeddem
pillars.heading: Krad n tgejda
pillars.sub: Ayen akk i nxeddem yeẓẓa deg liman, tasuddit d umyannan.
pillars.p1_desc: Amkan i unadi n wazalen n Islam s tdukli, yeẓẓan deg uḥnin.
pillars.p2_desc: Nessuddu tannumi n imeslmen deg ikalan n tesdawit, StOr d SiS.
pillars.p3_desc: Imyannanen d igrawen n leqraya i d-issawalen i medden akk ɣer wawal uṣil.

events.label: Tidyanin i d-iteddun
events.heading: D acu i d-iḍerrun?
events.empty: Ulac tidyanin i d-iteddun tura — uɣal-d cwiṭ.
events.prog1_desc: Imyannanen yeldin ɣef liman, timagit d tmetti gar yal asatal.
events.prog2_desc: Tadeggit n učči, idles d tmetti seg umaḍal meṛṛa.
events.prog3_desc: Jjemɛa n yal dduṛt s lxuṭba deg uxxam n teẓallit n tesdawit.
events.prog4_desc: Ifecka ilelliyen i wakken ad tferzeḍ deg leqraya ad tesserseḍ tudert.

membership.label: Ili d aḥric seg-neɣ
membership.heading: Yal anelmad ameslem n tesdawit ɣur-s amkan dagi
membership.success_text: Tanemmirt imi i d-terniḍ. Ad k-d-nermes s yilɣa n tedyanin cwiṭ kan.
membership.quote: «Wid yumnen d atmaten kan i llan.» — Quran 49:10
membership.benefit_1_desc: Issin ɣef akk tedyanin n MSiS

about.story_heading: Axxam n tesdawit i inelmaden imeslmen
about.story_text: MSiS tebda d tasenfart n inelmaden i wakken ad d-tefk i inelmaden imeslmen n tesdawit tawennaḍt yettallalen. Ass-a nxeddem i tudert n inelmaden yeẓẓan deg liman s wahilen, tabɣest d ucrak.
about.glance_heading: Yeldin, s inelmaden, yettmuqulen ɣer uzekka
about.glance_text: Nekni d tuddsa ur nelli ara tadamsant, tilellit deg tsertit. Ayen akk i nxeddem ssuddun-t iɛeggalen-nneɣ yeẓẓa deg wazalen n Islam: aḥnin, tamusni d uḥraz n tmetti.
about.focus_value: Yeldin · S inelmaden · Yettmuqulen ɣer uzekka
about.purpose_text: Iswi-nneɣ d allal n inelmaden imeslmen s wudem aṛuḥan, aɣerfan d unmettan — d ubennu n tleggwa n tegmi ger tmetti n inelmaden meṛṛa.
about.constitution_mission: Asnerni n tdukli, leqraya d umyannan ger inelmaden imeslmen n tesdawit.
about.constitution_membership: Teldi tsettili baṭel i akk inelmaden yebḍan azalen-nneɣ.
about.constitution_governance: Yettwasefrek s tegrawla s usqamu yettwafernen d ugraw amatu n useggas.
about.collab_text: Nxeddem s lqerb akked tesdawit, SiS d StOr i wakken ad tettwasel taɣect n inelmaden imeslmen deg yiɣtasen i isewjaden tudert n tesdawit.

contact.label: Nermes MSiS
contact.heading: Nebɣa ad nsel ɣur-k
contact.sub: Nermes s yisteqsiyen, tismucta n ucrak, neɣ i wesmekti n temlilit d usqamu.
contact.location_text: Timlilin n MSiS ṭṭurunt deg uxxam n teẓallit Kjølv Egeland d uwanak n inelmaden SiS (taxxamt Ø-110).

prayer.label: Taɛbadt n wass · Uwanak n inelmaden SiS taxxamt Ø-110
prayer.heading: Lewqat n teẓallit i Stavanger
prayer.sub: Qqim d amsedrar d semmus n teẓallliwin n wass mi tellid deg tesdawit.
prayer.tips_method: Lewqat ttwasiḍnen s tarrayt n Muslim World League i Stavanger.
prayer.tips_wudu: Mmekti-d luḍu uqbel teẓallit — llan yimukan ɣer tama n uxxam n teẓallit.
prayer.reminders_friday: Taẓallit n Jjemɛa tettwaberreḥ yal dduṛt s Instagram d yimayl.
prayer.reminders_spaces: Axxam n teẓallit deg uxxam Kjølv Egeland d texxamt Ø-110 ldin i akk inelmaden.

ramadan.label: Ayyur ameṛbuḥ
ramadan.heading: Ṛemḍan d MSiS
ramadan.sub: Ahil n lefṭur, taxemmemt d tmetti deg wayyur ameṛbuḥ meṛṛa.
ramadan.countdown_over: Ṛemḍan yekfa — ar useggas i d-iteddun, insha Allah.
ramadan.iftar_text: Rnu ɣer kuẓ n lefṭuṛat n tmetti deg wayyur — bḍu učči, taẓallit d wawal.
ramadan.reflection_text: Timlilin n yal dduṛt i texemmemt, taɣuri n Quran d uččur aṛuḥan s tdukli.
